_doc: Magician line skills (books 200 First Job Magician, 210 F/P, 220 I/L, 230 Cleric). Entry format and tier rules: see ../skills.json _doc.

energy_bolt._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses from legacy behaviour cards; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8.
energy_bolt.name: Energy Bolt
energy_bolt.desc: Fires a bolt of energy at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a bolt of energy.

magic_claw._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses from legacy behaviour cards; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8.
magic_claw.name: Magic Claw
magic_claw.desc: Rakes the nearest monster twice with a magic claw.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monsters twice each with a magic claw.

magic_armor.name: Magic Armor
magic_armor.desc: Magic hardens your armor: higher weapon defence against touch damage.

holy_arrow.name: Holy Arrow
holy_arrow.desc: Cleric. Shoots a holy arrow at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster by firing Holy Arrows. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

holy_arrow._tuning: Tier C: same flight, reach, radius and recast as Fire Arrow; canonical mad/mastery/mpCon and holy element are tier A.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Restores HP below half health, or strikes undead inside its holy box.

text.desc: Recovers your HP when it falls below half, and damages every undead monster in the area.

heal._heal: Tier A: mpCon/hp/lt/rb from v83. Tier B: undead formula; weak historical recovery coefficients. Tier C: provisional choice of the unverified single-target recovery fit (docs/research/cleric-heal.md), below-half trigger, 2 s recast, every undead in the box, 0.8 s stance.

cold_beam.name: Cold Beam
cold_beam.desc: Freezes the nearest monster with an icy beam.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a sharp piece of ice. The monster will freeze if hit. Fire-based monsters take 1.5 times the damage, ice-based monsters half.
text.h: Basic attack {mad}, mastery {mastery_pct}%, up to {count|monster|monsters}, freeze for {time} sec.

cold_beam._survivor: Tier C: nearest-target auto-cast, 1.25 s cooldown, 300 px range, one target, swingO1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: hit/effect only (no ball), elemAttr i, mad/mastery/mpCon and freeze time from the canonical level; no prop field, so every damaging hit attempts freeze through on_hit.

thunder_bolt.name: Thunder Bolt

text.desc: Attacks surrounding monsters with a thunder bolt.

thunder_bolt._survivor: Tier C: auto-cast with at least one monster in the canonical box, 1.5 s cooldown, swingO1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: lt/rb/mobCount, mad/mastery/mpCon and elemAttr l from Skill.wz; hit/effect only (no ball).

fire_arrow._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses from legacy behaviour cards; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8.
fire_arrow.name: Fire Arrow
fire_arrow.desc: Fire/Poison Wizard. Shoots a flaming arrow at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a fire arrow using the magic power. Ice-based monsters take 1.5 times the damage, fire-based monsters half.

fire_arrow._tier: Tier A: canonical mad/mastery/mpCon, elemAttr f and 30 levels. Tier C: nearest auto-cast, cooldown 1 s, range 480 px, speed 520 px/s, count 1, pierce 0, radius 12 px, action time 0.8 s, projectile rotation.

poison_breath._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses from legacy behaviour cards; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8.
poison_breath.name: Poison Breath
poison_breath.desc: Fires a poisonous orb at the nearest monster, with a chance to poison on hit.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster by splashing a Poison drop. With a given success rate, the monster gets temporarily poisoned.

poison_breath._tier: Tier A: canonical mad/mastery/mpCon, elemAttr s, prop/time and 30 levels; swingO3 action and cached visuals/sounds. Tier C: nearest auto-cast, cooldown 1.25 s, range 450 px, speed 400 px/s, count 1, pierce 0, radius 14 px, action time 0.8 s, no projectile rotation; existing status-system poison rules apply.

slow_fp.name: Slow
slow_fp.desc: Slows up to six eligible monsters when at least three unslowed monsters are in the skill box.
slow_fp._cast: Tier C: auto-cast at three eligible unslowed mobs, 1 s cooldown; at most two consecutive successful Slow casts per logical mob. A successful cast excluding it breaks the sequence; expiry/relocation do not. Canonical signed x/time/mobCount/lt/rb remain tier A.
